example.zh: 阳光照耀着整个校园，大家心情都很好。
example.en: Sunlight shines over the whole campus, and everyone is in a good mood.

example.zh: 他每个月都把工资的一部分用来储蓄。
example.en: Every month he puts part of his salary into savings.

example.zh: 这座城市正在修建一条新的地铁线。
example.en: The city is building a new subway line.

盘旋.gloss: to circle; to spiral; to hover

example.zh: 一只老鹰在山顶上空盘旋了很久。
example.en: An eagle circled above the mountaintop for a long time.

example.zh: 她买了几个橙，准备做果汁。
example.en: She bought a few oranges to make juice.

example.zh: 懒惰的人很难在工作中取得成功。
example.en: Lazy people find it hard to succeed at work.

example.zh: 他不甘心过平庸的生活，决定出去闯一闯。
example.en: Unwilling to live an ordinary life, he decided to go out and try his luck.

example.zh: 她小心翼翼地把花瓶放在桌子上。
example.en: She set the vase on the table with great care.

example.zh: 妈妈做的饭菜非常可口。
example.en: The food Mum makes is very tasty.

example.zh: 她一直默默地支持着丈夫的事业。
example.en: She has always quietly supported her husband's career.

example.zh: 这部电影的题材来自一个真实的故事。
example.en: The subject of this film comes from a true story.

糟蹋.gloss: to waste; to ruin; to spoil

example.zh: 吃不完也不要糟蹋粮食。
example.en: Even if you can't finish it, don't waste food.

example.zh: 自行车放在外面淋雨，很快就生锈了。
example.en: Left out in the rain, the bike soon got rusty.

example.zh: 博物馆里展出了很多珍贵的文物。
example.en: Many precious cultural relics are on display in the museum.

example.zh: 我们公司实行弹性工作时间。
example.en: Our company has flexible working hours.

example.zh: 每个个体都有自己的特点，不能一概而论。
example.en: Every individual has their own traits; you can't generalise.

陶醉.gloss: to be intoxicated (by); to be enchanted; to revel in

example.zh: 大家都陶醉在美妙的音乐中。
example.en: Everyone was enchanted by the beautiful music.

赠送.gloss: to give as a present; to present

example.zh: 商店向每位顾客赠送一份小礼品。
example.en: The shop gives every customer a small gift.

example.zh: 夏天我们常去海滨度假。
example.en: In summer we often go to the seaside on holiday.

example.zh: 今年雨水充足，庄稼长得特别好。
example.en: There was plenty of rain this year, so the crops grew very well.

就职.gloss: to take office; to assume a post

example.zh: 新校长下个月正式就职。
example.en: The new principal formally takes office next month.

example.zh: 小狗叼着一只拖鞋跑了过来。
example.en: The puppy came running over with a slipper in its mouth.

example.zh: 凡是参加比赛的同学都能得到一份纪念品。
example.en: Every student who takes part in the contest gets a souvenir.

example.zh: 在晨雾中只能看到远山的轮廓。
example.en: In the morning mist only the outline of the distant mountains could be seen.

example.zh: 汉字经过几千年的演变才成为今天的样子。
example.en: Chinese characters evolved over thousands of years into their present form.

example.zh: 她被选为学生会的委员。
example.en: She was elected a member of the student council.

example.zh: 植物吸收二氧化碳，释放氧气。
example.en: Plants absorb carbon dioxide and release oxygen.

example.zh: 写作文时要使用规范的汉字。
example.en: Use standard Chinese characters when writing compositions.

烘.gloss: to bake; to dry or warm by a fire

example.zh: 她把湿衣服放在炉子旁边烘干。
example.en: She put the wet clothes by the stove to dry.

example.zh: 狗的鼻子非常灵敏，能闻到很远的气味。
example.en: A dog's nose is very sensitive and can smell things far away.

example.zh: 他工作努力，去年晋升为部门经理。
example.en: He works hard and was promoted to department manager last year.

example.zh: 这里四季分明，风景很美。
example.en: The four seasons here are distinct, and the scenery is beautiful.

example.zh: 他把外套挂在门后的钩子上。
example.en: He hung his coat on the hook behind the door.

example.zh: 山上气压低，水不到一百度就开了。
example.en: The air pressure is low in the mountains, so water boils below 100 degrees.

恰巧.gloss: by chance; as it happens; coincidentally

example.zh: 我去找他时，他恰巧不在家。
example.en: When I went to see him, he happened to be out.

example.zh: 他的书法已经达到了很高的境界。
example.en: His calligraphy has reached a very high level.

example.zh: 老师要求我们明天做一个口头报告。
example.en: The teacher asked us to give an oral report tomorrow.

创立.gloss: to found; to establish; to create

example.zh: 这家公司是他二十年前创立的。
example.en: He founded this company twenty years ago.

不禁.indonesian: tidak dapat menahan diri; mau tidak mau

example.zh: 听到这个好消息，她不禁笑了起来。
example.en: Hearing the good news, she couldn't help laughing.

example.zh: 考察队在山脚下驻扎了一个星期。
example.en: The expedition team camped at the foot of the mountain for a week.

example.zh: 你这样做太不合情理了。
example.en: What you've done really doesn't make sense.

example.zh: 毕业典礼在庄严的气氛中举行。
example.en: The graduation ceremony was held in a solemn atmosphere.

example.zh: 饭后不要马上做剧烈运动。
example.en: Don't do strenuous exercise right after a meal.

example.zh: 这孩子太任性了，想要什么就一定要得到。
example.en: This child is too wilful; whatever he wants he must have.

example.zh: 公司目前面临着严峻的挑战。
example.en: The company is currently facing severe challenges.

example.zh: 这些成果是大家辛勤劳动的结果。
example.en: These achievements are the result of everyone's hard work.

蹬.gloss: to pedal; to press down with the foot; to step on

example.zh: 他用力蹬着自行车，很快就到了学校。
example.en: He pedalled hard and soon reached the school.

example.zh: 这座大楼看起来很有气势。
example.en: This building looks very imposing.

example.zh: 专家呼吁大家少用塑料袋。
example.en: Experts are calling on everyone to use fewer plastic bags.

example.zh: 他的回答很含糊，让人听不明白。
example.en: His answer was vague and hard to understand.

example.zh: 他是个君子，从来不说别人的坏话。
example.en: He's a gentleman who never speaks ill of others.

反面.gloss: reverse side; back; opposite; negative side

example.zh: 请把答案写在试卷的反面。
example.en: Please write your answers on the back of the test paper.

example.zh: 她因卓越的研究成果获得了大奖。
example.en: She won a major award for her outstanding research.

充当.gloss: to serve as; to act as; to play the role of

example.zh: 在这次会议上，他充当翻译。
example.en: At this meeting he acted as interpreter.

不愧.gloss: to be worthy of; to deserve to be called

example.zh: 他不愧是全国有名的厨师，做的菜真好吃。
example.en: He truly deserves his fame as a top chef; his food is delicious.

领悟.gloss: to comprehend; to grasp; to realise

example.zh: 经过老师的讲解，他终于领悟了其中的道理。
example.en: After the teacher's explanation, he finally grasped the principle.

过瘾.gloss: to satisfy a craving; to enjoy oneself to the full; satisfying

example.zh: 这场球赛看得真过瘾！
example.en: That match was so satisfying to watch!

example.zh: 年轻就是你最大的资本。
example.en: Being young is your greatest asset.

筛选.gloss: to screen; to select; to filter

example.zh: 公司从一百多份简历中筛选出十个人参加面试。
example.en: From over a hundred CVs the company shortlisted ten people for interviews.

example.zh: 他穿上西装显得很潇洒。
example.en: He looks very dashing in a suit.

搁.gloss: to put; to place; to put aside

example.zh: 你把行李先搁在门口吧。
example.en: Just put your luggage by the door for now.

example.zh: 她专门研究中国当代文学。
example.en: She specialises in contemporary Chinese literature.

example.zh: 这种石头非常坚硬，很难切开。
example.en: This kind of stone is very hard and difficult to cut.

example.zh: 这种植物的生长周期大约是三个月。
example.en: This plant's growth cycle is about three months.

example.zh: 他竟然公然违反学校的规定。
example.en: He actually broke the school rules openly.

齐心协力.gloss: to work together with one heart; concerted efforts

example.zh: 只要大家齐心协力，就一定能按时完成任务。
example.en: As long as we all work together, we'll finish the task on time.

example.zh: 这位医生的医术十分高超。
example.en: This doctor's medical skill is superb.

高涨.gloss: to surge; to run high; upsurge

example.zh: 比赛快开始了，观众的情绪越来越高涨。
example.en: As the match was about to begin, the crowd grew more and more excited.

example.zh: 她以顽强的毅力战胜了疾病。
example.en: She beat the illness with tenacious willpower.

逢.gloss: to meet; to come across; every time (on)

example.zh: 每逢春节，我们全家都会聚在一起。
example.en: Every Spring Festival our whole family gets together.

example.zh: 他是一位资深记者，采访过很多名人。
example.en: He is a veteran journalist who has interviewed many celebrities.

example.zh: 我经常在网上论坛和别人交流学习经验。
example.en: I often share study tips with others on online forums.

example.zh: 这家公司非常重视员工的综合素质。
example.en: This company puts great emphasis on employees' overall quality.

example.zh: 有了文凭不等于有了能力。
example.en: Having a diploma doesn't mean having ability.

寄托.gloss: to place (hope, feelings) on; to entrust; sustenance

example.zh: 父母把所有的希望都寄托在他身上。
example.en: His parents placed all their hopes on him.

example.zh: 我们要透过现象看实质。
example.en: We must look past the appearance to the essence.

example.zh: 奶奶坐在窗边，脸上带着安详的微笑。
example.en: Grandma sat by the window with a serene smile on her face.

丙.gloss: third (in a series); C (grade); third of the ten Heavenly Stems
丙.indonesian: ketiga (dalam urutan); C (nilai); batang langit ketiga

example.zh: 他这次考试只得了丙，心里很难过。
example.en: He only got a C on this exam and felt very upset.

上任.gloss: to take office; to assume a post

example.zh: 新经理上任以后，做了很多改革。
example.en: After taking office, the new manager made many reforms.

鉴别.gloss: to distinguish; to discern; to identify

example.zh: 专家可以鉴别这幅画是不是真的。
example.en: Experts can tell whether this painting is genuine.

example.zh: 他郑重地向大家道了歉。
example.en: He solemnly apologised to everyone.

example.zh: 英语是国际上通用的语言之一。
example.en: English is one of the languages in general international use.

example.zh: 元宵节晚上，孩子们喜欢猜谜语。
example.en: On Lantern Festival night, children love guessing riddles.

example.zh: 他用蔑视的眼光看着那个骗子。
example.en: He looked at the swindler with contempt.

拥护.gloss: to support; to endorse; to uphold

example.zh: 这项新政策得到了居民的拥护。
example.en: The new policy won the support of residents.

example.zh: 这次培训的名额有限，请尽快报名。
example.en: Places on this training course are limited, so please sign up soon.

example.zh: 时间太仓促了，我们没来得及好好准备。
example.en: Time was too short; we didn't get to prepare properly.

example.zh: 牛奶里含有丰富的钙。
example.en: Milk is rich in calcium.

采购.gloss: to purchase (for an organisation); to procure; purchasing

example.zh: 她负责为公司采购办公用品。
example.en: She is in charge of buying office supplies for the company.

采纳.gloss: to adopt; to accept (a suggestion, plan)

example.zh: 经理采纳了我的建议。
example.en: The manager adopted my suggestion.

example.zh: 这位教授出版了很多学术著作。
example.en: This professor has published many academic works.

example.zh: 我只记得那天发生的一些片断。
example.en: I only remember a few fragments of what happened that day.

example.zh: 语言是沟通不同文化的桥梁。
example.en: Language is a bridge between different cultures.

example.zh: 把鸡蛋和面粉放在一起搅拌均匀。
example.en: Put the eggs and flour together and stir until evenly mixed.

example.zh: 这部小说揭露了社会上的一些丑恶现象。
example.en: This novel exposes some ugly phenomena in society.

example.zh: 请爱护草坪，不要随意践踏。
example.en: Please take care of the lawn and do not trample on it.

example.zh: 我们要主动学习，不能被动地等待。
example.en: We should learn actively, not wait passively.

甭.gloss: needn't; don't have to; no need to

example.zh: 你甭担心，我一个人能行。
example.en: Don't worry, I can manage on my own.

example.zh: 房间里的灯光很柔和，让人觉得很舒服。
example.en: The lighting in the room is soft and makes you feel comfortable.

example.zh: 他机智地回答了记者的问题。
example.en: He answered the reporter's question with quick wit.

example.zh: 他一直在寻觅一份适合自己的工作。
example.en: He has been looking for a job that suits him.

example.zh: 这座城市的人口密度非常高。
example.en: This city has a very high population density.

example.zh: 这样对待动物太不人道了。
example.en: Treating animals like this is really inhumane.

领会.gloss: to understand; to grasp; to comprehend

example.zh: 我没有完全领会老师的意思。
example.en: I didn't fully understand what the teacher meant.

example.zh: 这个消息不知道是谁走漏出去的。
example.en: No one knows who leaked this news.

example.zh: 一阵风吹过，地上落满了花瓣。
example.en: A gust of wind blew, and the ground was covered with petals.

推论.gloss: to infer; to deduce; inference; conclusion

example.zh: 根据这些数据，我们可以得出一个推论。
example.en: From these data we can draw an inference.

恰到好处.indonesian: pas sekali; tepat sekali; sesuai takaran

example.zh: 这道菜的咸淡恰到好处。
example.en: The saltiness of this dish is just right.

example.zh: 考试时千万不能大意，要仔细检查。
example.en: Never be careless in an exam; check carefully.

example.zh: 近年来，这个国家的经济有了飞跃的发展。
example.en: In recent years this country's economy has developed by leaps and bounds.

颠簸.gloss: to jolt; to bump; to toss

example.zh: 汽车在山路上颠簸了好几个小时。
example.en: The car jolted along the mountain road for hours.

example.zh: 学校是传播知识的重要阵地。
example.en: Schools are an important front for spreading knowledge.

example.zh: 每间教室都配备了电脑和投影仪。
example.en: Every classroom is equipped with a computer and projector.

example.zh: 做这道菜需要准备好几种调料。
example.en: You need several kinds of seasoning for this dish.

example.zh: 这本书是作者多年研究的精华。
example.en: This book is the essence of the author's years of research.

支出.gloss: to spend; to pay out; expenditure; expenses

example.zh: 这个月的支出比上个月多了很多。
example.en: This month's expenses are much higher than last month's.

example.zh: 旅行可以开阔我们的眼界。
example.en: Travel can broaden our horizons.

example.zh: 他的座右铭是“活到老，学到老”。
example.en: His motto is "Never too old to learn."

example.zh: 在电脑方面，我完全是个外行。
example.en: When it comes to computers, I'm a complete layman.

example.zh: 这里的土壤很肥沃，适合种水果。
example.en: The soil here is fertile and good for growing fruit.

留神.gloss: to be careful; to look out; to pay attention

example.zh: 下雨天路滑，走路要留神。
example.en: Roads are slippery on rainy days, so watch your step.

example.zh: 保护生态环境是每个人的责任。
example.en: Protecting the ecological environment is everyone's responsibility.

理睬.gloss: to pay attention to; to heed (usually negative)

example.zh: 我跟他打招呼，他却不理睬我。
example.en: I said hello to him, but he ignored me.

example.zh: 学生们在课上观察了昆虫标本。
example.en: The students examined insect specimens in class.

example.zh: 这家饭馆的菜分量很足。
example.en: The portions at this restaurant are generous.

凝视.gloss: to gaze at; to stare at

example.zh: 她凝视着窗外的大海，一句话也不说。
example.en: She gazed at the sea outside the window without saying a word.

example.zh: 这家商店的信誉很好，顾客都很放心。
example.en: This shop has a good reputation, so customers feel confident.

example.zh: 黄昏时，很多老人在公园里散步。
example.en: At dusk many elderly people stroll in the park.

请教.gloss: to consult; to ask for advice

example.zh: 遇到不懂的问题，你可以向老师请教。
example.en: When you meet a problem you don't understand, you can ask the teacher.

example.zh: 学生不能私自离开学校。
example.en: Students may not leave the school without permission.

泄气.gloss: to lose heart; to be discouraged; disappointing

example.zh: 失败一次没关系，千万别泄气。
example.en: One failure doesn't matter; don't lose heart.

example.zh: 他把父母留下的钱都挥霍光了。
example.en: He squandered all the money his parents left him.

example.zh: 雪花的形态各不相同。
example.en: Every snowflake has a different shape.

对策.gloss: countermeasure; strategy for dealing with something

example.zh: 面对这个问题，我们必须尽快想出对策。
example.en: Faced with this problem, we must come up with countermeasures quickly.

example.zh: 裁判一吹哨，比赛就开始了。
example.en: As soon as the referee blew the whistle, the game began.

遭殃.gloss: to suffer disaster; to be in trouble

example.zh: 河水一涨，岸边的庄稼都遭殃了。
example.en: When the river rose, the crops along the bank were ruined.

遗留.gloss: to leave behind; to hand down; left over

example.zh: 这些都是历史遗留下来的问题。
example.en: These are all problems left over from history.

还原.gloss: to restore (to original state); to recreate; to reduce (chemistry)
还原.indonesian: mengembalikan ke keadaan semula; memulihkan; reduksi (kimia)

example.zh: 这部电影真实地还原了当时的生活。
example.en: This film faithfully recreates life at that time.

example.zh: 数学是我最薄弱的科目。
example.en: Maths is my weakest subject.

example.zh: 这台精密仪器价格非常昂贵。
example.en: This precision instrument is very expensive.

example.zh: 学习语言要打下牢固的基础。
example.en: When learning a language, you need to lay a solid foundation.

example.zh: 孩子们看杂技表演看得入了迷。
example.en: The children were spellbound by the acrobatics show.

example.zh: 做决定的时候要考虑全局。
example.en: When making decisions, consider the big picture.

神仙.indonesian: dewa; makhluk abadi; orang yang hidup bebas

example.zh: 他退休后过着神仙一样的生活。
example.en: After retiring he lives a carefree life like an immortal.

瓦解.gloss: to collapse; to disintegrate; to break up

example.zh: 由于内部矛盾，这个团队很快就瓦解了。
example.en: Because of internal conflicts, the team soon fell apart.

晾.gloss: to dry in the air or sun; to ignore (someone)

example.zh: 天气好的时候，她喜欢把被子拿出去晾一晾。
example.en: When the weather is good, she likes to air the quilts outside.

example.zh: 采用新方法以后，效果十分显著。
example.en: After adopting the new method, the results were remarkable.

example.zh: 他工作能力强，很快就被提拔为主管。
example.en: He is very capable and was soon promoted to supervisor.

example.zh: 小王是经理最得力的助手。
example.en: Xiao Wang is the manager's most capable assistant.

example.zh: 长期熬夜会削弱身体的抵抗力。
example.en: Staying up late for long periods weakens the body's resistance.

example.zh: 元宵节的时候，我们一家人一起吃汤圆。
example.en: At the Lantern Festival our family eats sweet dumplings together.

以致.gloss: so that; with the result that (usually bad)

example.zh: 他平时不努力，以致考试没有通过。
example.en: He didn't work hard normally, so he failed the exam.

example.zh: 这次火灾是人为造成的。
example.en: This fire was caused by people.

一度.gloss: once; for a time; at one time

example.zh: 他一度想放弃学习汉语。
example.en: At one point he wanted to give up learning Chinese.

example.zh: 我收到了朋友婚礼的请柬。
example.en: I received an invitation to my friend's wedding.

裁员.gloss: to lay off staff; to cut jobs; layoffs

example.zh: 由于经营困难，公司决定裁员。
example.en: Because of business difficulties, the company decided to cut staff.

example.zh: 这本词典是几代学者心血的结晶。
example.en: This dictionary is the fruit of several generations of scholars' work.

example.zh: 春节期间，很多城市限制燃放烟花爆竹。
example.en: During Spring Festival, many cities restrict setting off fireworks and firecrackers.

example.zh: 海上起风了，波浪越来越大。
example.en: The wind picked up at sea and the waves grew bigger and bigger.

example.zh: 这次捐款的数额超过了一百万元。
example.en: The amount donated this time exceeded one million yuan.

example.zh: 他为自己当年的错误感到悔恨。
example.en: He feels deep remorse for his mistakes back then.

example.zh: 记者提出了一个很尖锐的问题。
example.en: The reporter asked a very pointed question.

example.zh: 图中这两条直线互相垂直。
example.en: The two straight lines in the diagram are perpendicular to each other.

告辞.gloss: to take leave; to say goodbye

example.zh: 时间不早了，我该告辞了。
example.en: It's getting late; I should take my leave.

example.zh: 他靠写作获得了一笔可观的收入。
example.en: He earns a considerable income from writing.

example.zh: 这家超市的商品种类非常齐全。
example.en: This supermarket has a complete range of goods.

example.zh: 这个城市以生产陶瓷闻名。
example.en: This city is famous for making ceramics.

example.zh: 请接受我们最诚挚的感谢。
example.en: Please accept our most sincere thanks.

example.zh: 第一次上台演讲时，他有些胆怯。
example.en: The first time he gave a speech on stage, he felt a little timid.

未免.gloss: rather; a bit too; truly (expresses mild criticism)

example.zh: 你这样说未免太过分了。
example.en: Saying that is rather going too far.

example.zh: 指南针是中国古代的四大发明之一。
example.en: The compass is one of ancient China's four great inventions.

example.zh: 这些鸟在大树上筑了巢穴。
example.en: These birds built nests in the big tree.

example.zh: 明天局部地区有小雨。
example.en: Tomorrow there will be light rain in some areas.

example.zh: 做数学题要先记住这些公式。
example.en: To do maths problems you first need to memorise these formulas.

雕刻.gloss: to carve; to engrave; carving; sculpture

example.zh: 这块木头上雕刻着精美的花纹。
example.en: Fine patterns are carved into this piece of wood.

example.zh: 这本书描写了社会各个阶层的生活。
example.en: This book depicts the lives of every social class.

example.zh: 新员工要先熟悉公司的规章制度。
example.en: New employees first need to get familiar with company rules and regulations.

example.zh: 那座老房子的木门已经腐朽了。
example.en: The wooden door of that old house has rotted.

example.zh: 你知道这个节日的来历吗？
example.en: Do you know the origin of this festival?

搓.gloss: to rub (with the hands); to roll between the hands

example.zh: 天太冷了，他不停地搓手。
example.en: It was so cold that he kept rubbing his hands.

example.zh: 这部小说充满悬念，让人一口气读完。
example.en: This novel is full of suspense; you read it in one sitting.

example.zh: 山上有一座有几百年历史的寺庙。
example.en: On the mountain there is a temple several hundred years old.

公认.indonesian: diakui secara umum; diakui semua orang

example.zh: 他是大家公认的最好的老师。
example.en: He is generally recognised as the best teacher.

阻挠.gloss: to obstruct; to thwart; to stand in the way

example.zh: 父母一开始阻挠他们结婚，后来才同意。
example.en: At first their parents stood in the way of their marriage, but later agreed.

间隔.gloss: interval; gap; to be separated by

example.zh: 两次服药之间要间隔四个小时。
example.en: There should be an interval of four hours between doses.

example.zh: 公司每个月给员工发交通补贴。
example.en: The company gives employees a monthly transport allowance.

example.zh: 生活是艺术创作的源泉。
example.en: Life is the source of artistic creation.

总而言之.gloss: in short; in a word; all in all

example.zh: 总而言之，这次旅行非常愉快。
example.en: All in all, the trip was very enjoyable.

告诫.gloss: to warn; to admonish; to exhort

example.zh: 父亲告诫我做人一定要诚实。
example.en: My father warned me always to be honest.

内涵.indonesian: makna yang terkandung; isi; kedalaman batin

example.zh: 这首诗的内涵很丰富。
example.en: This poem is rich in meaning.

交涉.gloss: to negotiate; to take up a matter with

example.zh: 经过多次交涉，对方终于同意退款。
example.en: After repeated negotiation, the other side finally agreed to a refund.

课题.gloss: research topic; project; problem to solve

example.zh: 他正在研究一个关于环境保护的课题。
example.en: He is working on a research project on environmental protection.

留恋.gloss: to be reluctant to leave; to miss; to yearn for

example.zh: 毕业时，大家都很留恋校园生活。
example.en: At graduation everyone was reluctant to leave campus life behind.

example.zh: 农民每天早上都要喂牲畜。
example.en: Farmers have to feed the livestock every morning.

涮火锅.gloss: to eat hot pot (dipping food in boiling broth)
涮火锅.indonesian: makan hotpot; mencelup makanan ke kuah hotpot

example.zh: 冬天和朋友一起涮火锅特别舒服。
example.en: Having hot pot with friends in winter is especially cosy.

example.zh: 会议的气氛很沉闷，没人愿意发言。
example.en: The atmosphere at the meeting was dull, and no one wanted to speak.

歪曲.gloss: to distort; to misrepresent; to twist

example.zh: 这篇报道歪曲了事实。
example.en: This report distorts the facts.

example.zh: 长期抽烟容易引起慢性病。
example.en: Long-term smoking can easily cause chronic illness.

保养.gloss: to maintain; to keep in good repair; to take care of (health)

example.zh: 汽车要定期保养才能用得久。
example.en: A car needs regular maintenance to last.

example.zh: 经过朋友的调解，两人终于和好了。
example.en: Through a friend's mediation, the two finally made up.

example.zh: 人老了以后，记忆力会逐渐衰退。
example.en: As people age, their memory gradually declines.

example.zh: 这部电影的立体效果非常好。
example.en: This film's 3D effects are very good.

example.zh: 大家纷纷为灾区捐赠物资。
example.en: Everyone donated supplies to the disaster area.

沉思.gloss: to ponder; to be lost in thought; contemplation

example.zh: 他坐在窗前，陷入了沉思。
example.en: He sat by the window, lost in thought.

example.zh: 这家酒店的档次很高，价格也贵。
example.en: This hotel is very upmarket, and the prices are high too.

巴不得.gloss: to be eager to; to wish earnestly; can't wait to
巴不得.indonesian: sangat berharap; ingin sekali; tidak sabar

example.zh: 孩子们巴不得早点放暑假。
example.en: The children can't wait for the summer holidays to start.

半途而废.gloss: to give up halfway; to leave unfinished
半途而废.indonesian: berhenti di tengah jalan; menyerah setengah jalan

example.zh: 学习要坚持下去，不能半途而废。
example.en: You must keep studying and not give up halfway.

酝酿.gloss: to brew; to ferment; to mull over; to prepare

example.zh: 这个计划已经酝酿了很长时间。
example.en: This plan has been in the making for a long time.

example.zh: 中国的航天事业发展得很快。
example.en: China's space industry is developing rapidly.

example.zh: 这件事引起了社会舆论的广泛关注。
example.en: This matter attracted wide public attention.

example.zh: 用完水请记得关好水龙头。
example.en: Please remember to turn off the tap after using water.

株.gloss: measure word for plants and trees; plant
株.indonesian: kata satuan untuk tanaman dan pohon; batang

example.zh: 院子里种了几株桃树。
example.en: Several peach trees are planted in the yard.

example.zh: 每个汉字都对应一个音节。
example.en: Each Chinese character corresponds to one syllable.

变质.gloss: to go bad; to deteriorate; to spoil

example.zh: 天气太热，牛奶很容易变质。
example.en: When it's very hot, milk goes bad easily.

example.zh: 老板不应该剥削员工的劳动。
example.en: Bosses shouldn't exploit their employees' labour.

example.zh: 双方希望通过谈判解决争端。
example.en: Both sides hope to settle the dispute through negotiation.

主流.gloss: mainstream; main trend; main current (of a river)

example.zh: 网上购物已经成为消费的主流。
example.en: Online shopping has become the mainstream of consumption.

跟前.indonesian: di depan; di dekat; di sisi

example.zh: 孩子们都围在奶奶跟前听她讲故事。
example.en: The children gathered around Grandma to hear her stories.

example.zh: 他被人诬陷偷了东西，心里很委屈。
example.en: He was falsely accused of stealing and felt badly wronged.

编织.gloss: to weave; to knit; to braid

example.zh: 奶奶正在给我编织一件毛衣。
example.en: Grandma is knitting a sweater for me.

example.zh: 他们用力划着桨，小船很快就到了对岸。
example.en: They rowed hard, and the little boat soon reached the other shore.

无理取闹.gloss: to make trouble for no reason; to be deliberately provocative
无理取闹.indonesian: membuat onar tanpa alasan; rewel tanpa alasan

example.zh: 你别无理取闹了，大家都在等你。
example.en: Stop making a fuss for no reason; everyone is waiting for you.

愣.gloss: to be stunned; to be dumbfounded; rash

example.zh: 听到这个消息，他一下子愣住了。
example.en: Hearing the news, he was stunned.

example.zh: 吃饭时要细细咀嚼，有利于消化。
example.en: Chew carefully when eating; it helps digestion.

阻拦.gloss: to stop; to obstruct; to bar the way

example.zh: 他想走，可是朋友们把他阻拦住了。
example.en: He wanted to leave, but his friends stopped him.

example.zh: 这本书写得很有趣味，孩子们都爱看。
example.en: This book is written in a fun way; the children all love it.

example.zh: 他大学学的是考古专业。
example.en: He studied archaeology at university.

敷衍.gloss: to go through the motions; to do perfunctorily; to fob off

example.zh: 对待工作要认真，不能敷衍。
example.en: You should take work seriously, not just go through the motions.

捆绑.gloss: to tie up; to bind; to bundle

example.zh: 他用绳子把这些旧书捆绑在一起。
example.en: He tied the old books together with string.

报销.gloss: to claim reimbursement; to be reimbursed; to write off

example.zh: 出差的车费可以回公司报销。
example.en: Fares for business trips can be reimbursed by the company.

example.zh: 报名将于本月三十号截止。
example.en: Registration closes on the 30th of this month.

弥漫.gloss: to fill the air; to permeate; to spread everywhere

example.zh: 厨房里弥漫着饭菜的香味。
example.en: The smell of food filled the kitchen.

example.zh: 这个行业有着广阔的发展前景。
example.en: This industry has broad prospects for development.

example.zh: 不能只凭容貌去判断一个人。
example.en: You can't judge a person by looks alone.

容纳.gloss: to hold; to accommodate; to have capacity for; to tolerate

example.zh: 这个体育馆可以容纳五万名观众。
example.en: This stadium can hold fifty thousand spectators.

example.zh: 现在很多家庭都用天然气做饭。
example.en: Many households now cook with natural gas.

example.zh: 这家公司专门提供汽车租赁服务。
example.en: This company specialises in car rental services.

example.zh: 考虑到他的特殊情况，学校破例让他补考。
example.en: Given his special circumstances, the school made an exception and let him resit the exam.

example.zh: 春天来了，到处都充满了生机。
example.en: Spring has come, and everything is full of life.

名副其实.gloss: worthy of the name; living up to its name

example.zh: 他是一位名副其实的好医生。
example.en: He is a good doctor in every sense of the word.

传授.gloss: to teach; to pass on (knowledge, skills); to impart

example.zh: 老师傅把手艺传授给了年轻人。
example.en: The old master passed his craft on to the young people.

example.zh: 别在背后说别人的闲话。
example.en: Don't gossip about people behind their backs.

example.zh: 请把申请表连同照片一起交上来。
example.en: Please hand in the application form together with your photo.

example.zh: 这家店的北京烤鸭味道很正宗。
example.en: The Peking duck at this place tastes very authentic.

拘束.gloss: ill at ease; constrained; to restrict

example.zh: 来我家就像在自己家一样，别拘束。
example.en: Make yourself at home here; don't feel awkward.

example.zh: 我们的眼光不能只局限于眼前的利益。
example.en: Our view shouldn't be limited to immediate gains.

example.zh: 政府采取了很多措施帮助大学生就业。
example.en: The government has taken many measures to help graduates find jobs.

example.zh: 我们公司的宗旨是顾客第一。
example.en: Our company's guiding principle is "customer first".

响应.gloss: to respond to; to answer (a call)

example.zh: 同学们积极响应学校的号召，参加了植树活动。
example.en: The students responded actively to the school's call and joined the tree planting.

example.zh: 他们一家人相处得非常和睦。
example.en: Their family gets along very harmoniously.

example.zh: 他是这次奖项的候选人之一，最后获了奖。
example.en: He was one of the candidates for the award and won in the end.

上游.gloss: upper reaches (of a river); advanced position

example.zh: 这座城市位于长江上游。
example.en: This city lies on the upper reaches of the Yangtze River.

example.zh: 学习汉字也有一些窍门。
example.en: There are some tricks to learning Chinese characters too.

example.zh: 今天天气晴朗，适合出去爬山。
example.en: It's sunny today, good for going hiking.

example.zh: 他是一个很有抱负的年轻人。
example.en: He is a young man of great ambition.

example.zh: 她性格开朗，大家都喜欢和她交朋友。
example.en: She is cheerful, and everyone likes being friends with her.

example.zh: 年轻人工作起来干劲十足。
example.en: Young people work with tremendous drive.

example.zh: 每天刷牙有助于保持口腔健康。
example.en: Brushing your teeth every day helps keep your mouth healthy.

凝固.gloss: to solidify; to congeal; to set

example.zh: 水在零度以下会凝固成冰。
example.en: Water freezes into ice below zero degrees.

example.zh: 读课文时要注意句子之间的停顿。
example.en: When reading texts aloud, mind the pauses between sentences.

example.zh: 他专程从上海赶来参加我的婚礼。
example.en: He made a special trip from Shanghai to attend my wedding.

example.zh: 这个官员因为贪污被撤职了。
example.en: This official was dismissed for embezzlement.

缠绕.gloss: to wind; to twine; to entangle

example.zh: 墙上缠绕着绿色的藤。
example.en: Green vines are winding around the wall.

example.zh: 有这么孝顺的孩子，真是您的福气。
example.en: It's truly your good fortune to have such dutiful children.

example.zh: 糖很容易在热水里溶解。
example.en: Sugar dissolves easily in hot water.

更正.gloss: to correct; to make a correction; correction

example.zh: 报纸第二天就更正了这个错误。
example.en: The newspaper corrected the error the next day.

日益.gloss: increasingly; day by day; more and more

example.zh: 人们的生活水平日益提高。
example.en: People's living standards are rising day by day.

example.zh: 我最近在读一本名人传记。
example.en: Recently I've been reading a celebrity biography.

缓和.gloss: to ease; to relieve; to alleviate; mild

example.zh: 他讲了个笑话，紧张的气氛缓和了下来。
example.en: He told a joke, and the tense atmosphere eased.

example.zh: 他才三十岁，头就有点秃了。
example.en: He's only thirty but already going a bit bald.

example.zh: 这家公司去年盈利两千万元。
example.en: The company made a profit of twenty million yuan last year.

example.zh: 这座建筑的设计左右对称，非常美观。
example.en: The building is symmetrical left and right and very attractive.

example.zh: 他看着成绩单，忍不住叹气。
example.en: Looking at his report card, he couldn't help sighing.

力所能及.gloss: within one's power; to the best of one's ability

example.zh: 孩子应该做一些力所能及的家务。
example.en: Children should do housework that is within their ability.

example.zh: 面对记者的提问，他显得十分从容。
example.en: Facing the reporters' questions, he appeared very calm.

独裁.gloss: dictatorship; autocratic; to rule as a dictator

example.zh: 他在家里很独裁，什么事都要自己决定。
example.en: He's a real dictator at home; he decides everything himself.

example.zh: 遇到紧急情况一定要沉着冷静。
example.en: In an emergency you must stay calm and composed.

example.zh: 他对这件事的态度很暧昧。
example.en: His attitude towards this matter is very ambiguous.

惋惜.gloss: to feel regret (for another); to sympathise; to pity

example.zh: 他没能参加决赛，大家都很惋惜。
example.en: Everyone felt it was a pity he couldn't take part in the final.

example.zh: 这里正在开采一座大型煤矿。
example.en: A large coal mine is being worked here.

example.zh: 这里地理位置优越，交通十分方便。
example.en: The location here is excellent and transport is very convenient.

example.zh: 这幅画的颜色非常鲜明。
example.en: The colours of this painting are very bright.

example.zh: 他说话很有条理，大家一听就懂。
example.en: He speaks in a very orderly way; everyone understands at once.

example.zh: 她举止文雅，说话也很温和。
example.en: She has refined manners and speaks gently.

包庇.gloss: to shield; to cover up for; to harbour

example.zh: 父母不应该包庇孩子的错误。
example.en: Parents shouldn't cover up their children's mistakes.

example.zh: 这张圆桌的直径是两米。
example.en: This round table is two metres in diameter.

example.zh: 这条胡同很狭窄，汽车开不进去。
example.en: This alley is too narrow for cars to get in.

滋润.gloss: moist; to moisten; to nourish; comfortable (life)

example.zh: 这种面霜可以滋润皮肤。
example.en: This face cream moisturises the skin.

example.zh: 这条街已经没有了昔日的热闹。
example.en: This street has lost the bustle of former days.

example.zh: 经过一年的努力，我们的工作取得了明显的成效。
example.en: After a year's effort, our work has produced clear results.

example.zh: 这款手机性能好，价格也不贵。
example.en: This phone performs well and isn't expensive.

心甘情愿.gloss: totally willing; gladly; of one's own free will
心甘情愿.indonesian: dengan rela hati; dengan senang hati

example.zh: 为了孩子，她心甘情愿做任何事情。
example.en: For her child, she would gladly do anything.

example.zh: 他很有钱，但是非常吝啬。
example.en: He's very rich but extremely stingy.

example.zh: 时间、地点和人物是记叙文的基本要素。
example.en: Time, place and characters are the basic elements of a narrative.

example.zh: 我很怀念小时候无忧无虑的日子。
example.en: I really miss the carefree days of my childhood.

拼搏.gloss: to struggle; to fight hard; to go all out

example.zh: 为了实现梦想，他一直在努力拼搏。
example.en: He has been fighting hard to make his dream come true.

example.zh: 参加面试时要穿得庄重一点。
example.en: Dress a bit more formally for a job interview.

example.zh: 这座宫殿看起来非常宏伟。
example.en: This palace looks truly magnificent.

孕育.gloss: to be pregnant with; to breed; to nurture; to give birth to

example.zh: 黄河孕育了古老的中华文明。
example.en: The Yellow River gave birth to ancient Chinese civilisation.

奔波.gloss: to rush about; to be busy running around

example.zh: 为了生活，他每天都在外面奔波。
example.en: To make a living, he's out rushing around every day.

example.zh: 他做事向来很认真，从不马虎。
example.en: He has always been conscientious in his work and is never sloppy.

勇于.gloss: to have the courage to; to dare to

example.zh: 我们要勇于承认自己的错误。
example.en: We should have the courage to admit our mistakes.

example.zh: 祝你在新的工作中一帆风顺！
example.en: I wish you smooth sailing in your new job!

example.zh: 这些设备已经很陈旧了，需要更换。
example.en: This equipment is very outdated and needs replacing.

茫茫.indonesian: luas tak bertepi; tak terhingga; samar-samar

example.zh: 一条小船在茫茫大海上漂着。
example.en: A small boat drifted on the boundless sea.

example.zh: 妈妈在枕头上绣了一朵花。
example.en: Mum embroidered a flower on the pillow.

example.zh: 她做事非常细致，从来不出错。
example.en: She works very meticulously and never makes mistakes.

example.zh: 春天的田野一片绿色，美极了。
example.en: The fields in spring are a sea of green, extremely beautiful.

摧残.gloss: to devastate; to wreck; to ruin (health etc.)

example.zh: 长期熬夜严重摧残了他的身体。
example.en: Staying up late for years has seriously wrecked his health.

example.zh: 出国前要注意哪些事项？
example.en: What matters should you pay attention to before going abroad?

example.zh: 这台电脑的运算速度非常快。
example.en: This computer's calculating speed is very fast.

example.zh: 他整天发牢骚，说工作太累。
example.en: He grumbles all day that work is too tiring.

example.zh: 他们花了两天时间攀登上了山顶。
example.en: It took them two days to climb to the summit.

example.zh: 他每个周末都去看望岳母。
example.en: He visits his mother-in-law every weekend.

动员.gloss: to mobilise; to arouse; to persuade

example.zh: 老师动员大家参加学校的运动会。
example.en: The teacher encouraged everyone to take part in the school sports meet.

凝聚.gloss: to condense; to gather; to embody; cohesion

example.zh: 这本书凝聚了他一生的心血。
example.en: This book embodies his whole life's effort.

example.zh: 饮食要有节制，不能想吃多少就吃多少。
example.en: Eat in moderation; don't eat as much as you like.

example.zh: 打开窗户让空气流通一下。
example.en: Open the windows to let the air circulate.

example.zh: 请大家按次序排队进场。
example.en: Please queue in order to enter.

example.zh: 我们要用批判的眼光看待网上的信息。
example.en: We should view online information with a critical eye.

example.zh: 他性格急躁，遇到事情容易发火。
example.en: He has an impatient temper and flares up easily.

example.zh: 他思索了很久，才回答这个问题。
example.en: He thought it over for a long time before answering.

example.zh: 这家公司专门研究尖端科技。
example.en: This company specialises in cutting-edge technology.

example.zh: 我们站在海边看夕阳慢慢落下。
example.en: We stood by the sea watching the sun slowly set.

example.zh: 这个古镇正在努力复兴传统手工艺。
example.en: This old town is working to revive traditional crafts.

example.zh: 这台电脑体积小，携带方便。
example.en: This computer is small and easy to carry.

example.zh: 他虽然很有成就，但是为人很谦逊。
example.en: Although very accomplished, he is very modest.

example.zh: 今年公司的资金还有很大的缺口。
example.en: There's still a big funding shortfall at the company this year.

example.zh: 冰箱里有现成的饭菜，热一下就能吃。
example.en: There's ready-made food in the fridge; just heat it up.

率领.gloss: to lead; to head; to command

example.zh: 校长率领代表团出国访问。
example.en: The principal led a delegation abroad on a visit.

example.zh: 他说这些话，无非是想让你高兴。
example.en: He said those things simply to make you happy.

example.zh: 这次项目让他充分展示了自己的才干。
example.en: This project allowed him to fully show his abilities.

example.zh: 教育可以帮助人们摆脱愚昧。
example.en: Education can help people escape ignorance.

example.zh: 新年到了，我们一起展望美好的未来。
example.en: The New Year has come; let's look ahead to a bright future together.

example.zh: 这片森林是城市的天然屏障。
example.en: This forest is a natural barrier for the city.

example.zh: 我嫂子做的菜特别好吃。
example.en: The food my sister-in-law cooks is especially delicious.

example.zh: 他的伤口发炎了，得马上去医院。
example.en: His wound got inflamed; he has to go to hospital right away.

example.zh: 她看着乐谱，认真地弹起了钢琴。
example.en: Reading the sheet music, she played the piano carefully.

example.zh: 他迟疑了一下，最后还是答应了。
example.en: He hesitated a moment but agreed in the end.

example.zh: 每年秋天，很多鸟都会向南方迁徙。
example.en: Every autumn many birds migrate south.

example.zh: 面对这么多选择，他感到一片茫然。
example.en: Faced with so many choices, he felt completely at a loss.

滔滔不绝.gloss: to talk on and on; to pour out words endlessly

example.zh: 一谈起足球，他就滔滔不绝。
example.en: Once he starts on football, he talks on and on.

example.zh: 这条山路又窄又曲折，很难走。
example.en: This mountain path is narrow and winding, and hard to walk.

惊动.gloss: to alarm; to disturb; to startle

example.zh: 他轻轻地走进房间，怕惊动熟睡的孩子。
example.en: He walked softly into the room, afraid of disturbing the sleeping child.

压缩.gloss: to compress; to reduce; to cut down

example.zh: 我们要压缩开支，节约用钱。
example.en: We need to cut spending and save money.

example.zh: 越来越多的人环保意识开始觉醒。
example.en: More and more people are waking up to environmental awareness.

索取.gloss: to ask for; to demand; to request

example.zh: 你可以向工作人员索取免费的地图。
example.en: You can ask the staff for a free map.

示意.gloss: to signal; to gesture; to hint

example.zh: 老师示意我们安静下来。
example.en: The teacher signalled for us to be quiet.

example.zh: 父亲对我的爱是深沉的。
example.en: My father's love for me runs deep.

example.zh: 下课后要及时复习，巩固学过的知识。
example.en: Review promptly after class to consolidate what you've learned.

阐述.gloss: to expound; to set forth; to elaborate

example.zh: 他在论文中详细阐述了自己的观点。
example.en: He set out his views in detail in his paper.

example.zh: 这里的气候很适宜种茶。
example.en: The climate here is well suited to growing tea.

过问.gloss: to concern oneself with; to take an interest in; to get involved

example.zh: 这是我的私事，请你不要过问。
example.en: This is my private business; please don't get involved.

败坏.gloss: to ruin; to corrupt; to undermine; corrupt

example.zh: 这种行为会败坏学校的名声。
example.en: This kind of behaviour will ruin the school's reputation.

example.zh: 他亲自把请帖送到了每位客人手中。
example.en: He personally delivered the invitation to every guest.

耗费.gloss: to consume; to expend; to waste

example.zh: 这项工作耗费了我们大量的时间。
example.en: This work consumed a great deal of our time.

泛滥.gloss: to flood; to overflow; to spread unchecked

example.zh: 网上的虚假信息泛滥，要学会辨别。
example.en: False information is rampant online; you need to learn to tell it apart.

example.zh: 我听不懂这个地方的方言。
example.en: I can't understand the local dialect here.

培育.gloss: to cultivate; to breed; to nurture

example.zh: 科学家培育出了一种新的水稻品种。
example.en: Scientists have bred a new variety of rice.

停滞.gloss: to stagnate; to be at a standstill

example.zh: 由于缺少资金，这个项目停滞不前。
example.en: Due to a lack of funds, the project has stalled.

example.zh: 加油站附近严禁吸烟。
example.en: Smoking is strictly prohibited near petrol stations.

转折.indonesian: titik balik; perubahan arah; berbalik arah

example.zh: 这次比赛是他人生的一个重要转折。
example.en: This competition was an important turning point in his life.

表彰.gloss: to commend; to honour; to cite

example.zh: 学校表彰了一批优秀教师。
example.en: The school honoured a group of outstanding teachers.

example.zh: 公司计划在若干年内开设十家分店。
example.en: The company plans to open ten branches within a number of years.

牵制.gloss: to hold back; to contain; to tie down

example.zh: 他总觉得工作受到很多方面的牵制。
example.en: He always feels his work is held back by many factors.

example.zh: 孩子还没回家，妈妈焦急地等着。
example.en: The child wasn't home yet, and Mum waited anxiously.

example.zh: 夏天这里非常炎热，最高温度超过四十度。
example.en: Summers here are scorching, with highs over forty degrees.

权衡.gloss: to weigh (up); to balance (pros and cons)

example.zh: 他权衡了利弊，最后决定换工作。
example.en: After weighing the pros and cons, he decided to change jobs.

example.zh: 床边有一个插座，可以给手机充电。
example.en: There's a socket by the bed for charging your phone.

打量.gloss: to size up; to look someone up and down; to reckon
打量.indonesian: memperhatikan dari atas sampai bawah; mengamati; mengira

example.zh: 她上下打量着这位新来的同事。
example.en: She looked the new colleague up and down.

应酬.gloss: to socialise; to entertain; social engagement

example.zh: 他工作上的应酬太多，很少在家吃饭。
example.en: He has so many work dinners that he rarely eats at home.

example.zh: 科学家们一直在探索宇宙的奥秘。
example.en: Scientists keep exploring the mysteries of the universe.

example.zh: 他回答问题的声音很响亮。
example.en: He answered the question in a loud, clear voice.

划分.gloss: to divide; to partition; to differentiate

example.zh: 老师把全班划分成五个小组。
example.en: The teacher divided the class into five groups.

example.zh: 他在一所大学附属医院工作。
example.en: He works at a university-affiliated hospital.

example.zh: 因为个子矮，他一直有点自卑。
example.en: Because he's short, he has always felt a bit inferior.

example.zh: 老师让我们背诵这首古诗。
example.en: The teacher asked us to recite this classical poem.

example.zh: 公园里的樱花都盛开了。
example.en: The cherry blossoms in the park are in full bloom.

example.zh: 河水汹涌，船只暂时不能通行。
example.en: The river is surging, so boats can't pass for now.

example.zh: 学好一门外语需要很大的毅力。
example.en: Mastering a foreign language takes great perseverance.

敬业.gloss: dedicated to one's work; professional dedication

example.zh: 他是一位非常敬业的老师，经常加班备课。
example.en: He is a very dedicated teacher who often stays late preparing lessons.

拔苗助长.gloss: to spoil things through excessive enthusiasm (lit. pulling up shoots to help them grow)
拔苗助长.indonesian: terburu-buru sehingga merusak; memaksakan hasil cepat

example.zh: 教育孩子要有耐心，不能拔苗助长。
example.en: Raising children takes patience; you can't force their growth.

当务之急.indonesian: prioritas utama; hal yang paling mendesak

example.zh: 当务之急是先把病人送到医院。
example.en: The top priority is to get the patient to hospital first.

对立.gloss: to oppose; to be opposed; opposite

example.zh: 他们的观点完全对立，谁也说服不了谁。
example.en: Their views are completely opposed; neither can convince the other.

example.zh: 孩子的到来给家里增添了很多欢乐。
example.en: The baby's arrival has added a lot of joy to the family.

example.zh: 多沟通可以消除两代人之间的隔阂。
example.en: More communication can remove the gulf between generations.

譬如.gloss: for example; for instance; such as

example.zh: 我喜欢很多运动，譬如游泳、跑步和打球。
example.en: I like many sports, for example swimming, running and ball games.

example.zh: 他吃了不干净的东西，结果腹泻了。
example.en: He ate something unclean and ended up with diarrhoea.

example.zh: 这个月的销售指标已经完成了。
example.en: This month's sales target has been met.

example.zh: 这个节目内容庸俗，观众不喜欢。
example.en: The content of this programme is vulgar; audiences don't like it.

example.zh: 请把这些文件妥善保管。
example.en: Please keep these documents safe.

example.zh: 良好的习惯为成功打下了坚实的基础。
example.en: Good habits lay a solid foundation for success.

启事.gloss: notice; announcement (posted or in a newspaper)

example.zh: 他在报纸上登了一则寻物启事。
example.en: He placed a lost-property notice in the newspaper.

example.zh: 她在学校负责后勤工作。
example.en: She is in charge of support services at the school.

example.zh: 这几年，这座城市的面貌发生了很大变化。
example.en: In recent years the look of this city has changed enormously.

雌雄.gloss: male and female; victory and defeat
雌雄.indonesian: jantan dan betina; kalah atau menang

example.zh: 这种鸟的雌雄很难分辨。
example.en: It's hard to tell the males and females of this bird apart.

example.zh: 这两门课的上课时间重叠了。
example.en: The class times of these two courses overlap.

相差.gloss: to differ; difference; to be apart

example.zh: 我和哥哥的年龄相差五岁。
example.en: My brother and I are five years apart in age.

example.zh: 这本书的内容太深奥了，我看不懂。
example.en: This book's content is too abstruse for me to understand.

example.zh: 出发前，他们制订了周密的计划。
example.en: Before setting off, they drew up a thorough plan.

example.zh: 那只狗看起来很凶恶，其实很温顺。
example.en: That dog looks fierce but is actually very docile.

example.zh: 这口大钟是用铜铸造的。
example.en: This big bell was cast in bronze.

example.zh: 好几天没浇水，花都枯萎了。
example.en: The flowers withered after several days without water.

投掷.gloss: to throw; to hurl; to toss

example.zh: 他在运动会上参加了铅球投掷比赛。
example.en: He took part in the shot put event at the sports meet.

example.zh: 最近气温急剧下降，大家要注意保暖。
example.en: Temperatures have dropped sharply recently; keep warm.

example.zh: 父母都希望孩子将来有出息。
example.en: All parents hope their children will make something of themselves.

example.zh: 她以优异的成绩考上了名牌大学。
example.en: She got into a top university with outstanding results.

example.zh: 电视台正在播放一个关于环保的专题节目。
example.en: The TV station is broadcasting a special programme on the environment.

鼓动.gloss: to agitate; to incite; to encourage; to arouse

example.zh: 在朋友的鼓动下，他报名参加了马拉松。
example.en: Egged on by his friends, he signed up for the marathon.

雪上加霜.gloss: one disaster after another; to make things worse
雪上加霜.indonesian: sudah jatuh tertimpa tangga; memperburuk keadaan

example.zh: 他刚丢了工作，又生了病，真是雪上加霜。
example.en: He just lost his job and then fell ill; misfortune never comes singly.

转让.gloss: to transfer (ownership); to make over; to sell (rights, shop)

example.zh: 这家小店因为老板要出国，准备转让。
example.en: The owner is moving abroad, so this little shop is up for transfer.

example.zh: 这个问题不属于我们讨论的范畴。
example.en: This question falls outside the scope of our discussion.

致辞.gloss: to make a speech (on a formal occasion); address

example.zh: 在开幕式上，校长向来宾致辞。
example.en: At the opening ceremony, the principal addressed the guests.

example.zh: 他从小就喜欢田径运动，特别是短跑。
example.en: He has loved athletics since childhood, especially sprinting.

摸索.gloss: to grope for; to feel one's way; to explore

example.zh: 经过多年的摸索，他终于找到了适合自己的学习方法。
example.en: After years of trial and error, he finally found a study method that suits him.

example.zh: 工厂不能把污水直接排放到河里。
example.en: Factories may not discharge waste water straight into rivers.

example.zh: 冰是水在低温下的固体形态。
example.en: Ice is the solid form of water at low temperatures.

伯母.gloss: aunt (wife of father's elder brother); polite term for a friend's mother
伯母.indonesian: bibi (istri kakak ayah); tante (sebutan sopan untuk ibu teman)

example.zh: 伯母，您做的菜太好吃了！
example.en: Auntie, the food you made is delicious!

饲养.gloss: to raise; to rear; to keep (animals)

example.zh: 他在农村饲养了几百只鸡。
example.en: He raises several hundred chickens in the countryside.

迁就.gloss: to accommodate; to give in to; to humour

example.zh: 父母不能什么事都迁就孩子。
example.en: Parents can't give in to their children on everything.

example.zh: 我们坐轮船去了对面的岛上。
example.en: We took a steamer to the island across the water.

解体.gloss: to disintegrate; to break up; to collapse

example.zh: 这个乐队成立不到两年就解体了。
example.en: The band broke up less than two years after forming.

example.zh: 端午节的时候，很多地方都有龙舟比赛。
example.en: During the Dragon Boat Festival, many places hold dragon boat races.

example.zh: 这条鱼不新鲜，闻起来很腥。
example.en: This fish isn't fresh; it smells very fishy.

改良.gloss: to improve; to reform; to ameliorate

example.zh: 科学家正在改良这种水果的品种。
example.en: Scientists are improving the variety of this fruit.

example.zh: 这套房子的布局很合理。
example.en: The layout of this flat is very sensible.

example.zh: 今年的国际博览会吸引了很多游客。
example.en: This year's international expo attracted many visitors.

example.zh: 中国人民一向勤劳勇敢。
example.en: The Chinese people have always been hardworking and brave.

利害.gloss: gains and losses; advantages and disadvantages

example.zh: 他把其中的利害关系分析得很清楚。
example.en: He analysed the stakes involved very clearly.

作废.gloss: to become invalid; to be nullified; to void

example.zh: 这张优惠券已经过期作废了。
example.en: This coupon has expired and is no longer valid.

example.zh: 这部电影的演员阵容非常强大。
example.en: This film has a very strong cast.

example.zh: 这种零件的规格必须符合要求。
example.en: The specifications of these parts must meet the requirements.

统筹兼顾.gloss: to plan as a whole and take all factors into account
统筹兼顾.indonesian: merencanakan secara menyeluruh dan memperhatikan semua pihak

example.zh: 制订计划时要统筹兼顾，照顾各方面的利益。
example.en: When drawing up plans, consider everything and look after all interests.

简陋.gloss: simple and crude; shabby; poorly equipped
简陋.indonesian: sederhana dan seadanya; reyot; kurang lengkap

example.zh: 学校的条件虽然简陋，但老师们很认真。
example.en: Although the school's conditions are basic, the teachers are very dedicated.

example.zh: 政府简化了办理签证的手续。
example.en: The government has simplified the visa application procedures.

example.zh: 遇到问题时，他总是能果断地作出决定。
example.en: When problems arise, he always makes decisions decisively.

提炼.gloss: to extract; to refine; to purify; to distil (ideas)

example.zh: 这种油是从植物中提炼出来的。
example.en: This oil is extracted from plants.

example.zh: 大家都来了，唯独他没来。
example.en: Everyone came except him.

反思.gloss: to reflect on; to introspect; reflection

example.zh: 考试失败后，他认真反思了自己的学习方法。
example.en: After failing the exam, he seriously reflected on his study methods.

example.zh: 你这么晚才回家，也不打个电话，太不像话了！
example.en: Coming home this late without even calling is outrageous!

example.zh: 请查看邮件里的附件。
example.en: Please see the attachment in the email.

example.zh: 这次发明是科技史上的一座里程碑。
example.en: This invention is a milestone in the history of technology.

example.zh: 这一带以前很荒凉，现在建起了很多高楼。
example.en: This area used to be desolate; now many tall buildings stand here.

致使.gloss: to cause; to result in; so that

example.zh: 大雾致使很多航班推迟起飞。
example.en: The heavy fog caused many flights to be delayed.

example.zh: 奶奶从果园里摘了一筐苹果。
example.en: Grandma picked a basket of apples from the orchard.

example.zh: 光靠空想是不能实现梦想的。
example.en: You can't achieve your dreams by daydreaming alone.

狼狈.gloss: in a sorry plight; in an embarrassing situation; awkward
狼狈.indonesian: serba susah; dalam keadaan memalukan; kacau

example.zh: 突然下起大雨，没带伞的我狼狈极了。
example.en: It suddenly poured, and without an umbrella I was in a sorry state.

example.zh: 这条小河的水清澈见底。
example.en: The water of this stream is so clear you can see the bottom.

example.zh: 请按照规定的格式填写申请表。
example.en: Please fill in the application form in the required format.

example.zh: 公司的发展方针很明确。
example.en: The company's development policy is very clear.

投机.gloss: to speculate; opportunistic; congenial (getting on well)

example.zh: 我们俩谈得很投机，一聊就是几个小时。
example.en: We got along so well that we chatted for hours.

example.zh: 今年这个地区发生了严重的干旱。
example.en: This region suffered a severe drought this year.

example.zh: 他是一名地质学家，经常去野外考察。
example.en: He is a geologist and often does fieldwork.

example.zh: 中秋节是家人团圆的日子。
example.en: The Mid-Autumn Festival is a day for family reunion.

example.zh: 车站里人很多，非常嘈杂。
example.en: The station is crowded and very noisy.

号召.gloss: to call on; to appeal; call

example.zh: 学校号召学生节约用水。
example.en: The school is calling on students to save water.

发呆.gloss: to stare blankly; to be in a daze; to space out

example.zh: 他坐在窗前发呆，不知道在想什么。
example.en: He sat staring blankly by the window, lost in who knows what.

分红.gloss: to share profits; to pay dividends; dividend; bonus

example.zh: 公司年底会给员工分红。
example.en: The company shares profits with employees at the end of the year.

example.zh: 老人一个人住，晚年生活很凄凉。
example.en: Living alone, the old man had a lonely, dreary old age.

颁布.gloss: to promulgate; to issue; to announce (law, regulations)

example.zh: 政府颁布了新的环境保护法。
example.en: The government issued a new environmental protection law.

爽快.indonesian: terus terang; blak-blakan; segar; dengan senang hati

example.zh: 我请他帮忙，他爽快地答应了。
example.en: I asked him for help, and he readily agreed.

example.zh: 他昨晚没睡好，今天上课无精打采的。
example.en: He didn't sleep well last night and was listless in class today.

参照.gloss: to refer to; to consult; to use as a reference

example.zh: 你可以参照这个例子来完成作业。
example.en: You can refer to this example to do your homework.

example.zh: 科学家在这里发现了恐龙化石。
example.en: Scientists found dinosaur fossils here.

example.zh: 我们要采取切实可行的措施解决问题。
example.en: We must take practical, feasible measures to solve the problem.

丰收.gloss: bumper harvest; to have a good harvest

example.zh: 今年雨水充足，粮食获得了丰收。
example.en: With plenty of rain this year, there was a bumper grain harvest.

配套.gloss: to form a complete set; supporting; matching
配套.indonesian: menjadi satu set; pelengkap; fasilitas pendukung

example.zh: 这个小区的配套设施非常完善。
example.en: The supporting facilities in this residential area are very complete.

example.zh: 这位著名作家去年因病逝世。
example.en: This famous writer passed away from illness last year.

迸发.gloss: to burst out; to burst forth

example.zh: 听到这个消息，观众中迸发出热烈的掌声。
example.en: On hearing the news, the audience burst into warm applause.

example.zh: 董事长下午要召开一个重要会议。
example.en: The chairman is holding an important meeting this afternoon.

example.zh: 事实证明，经理的决定是英明的。
example.en: Events proved the manager's decision was wise.

example.zh: 请你简要地介绍一下自己。
example.en: Please briefly introduce yourself.

example.zh: 卖菜的阿姨用秤称了称这些西红柿。
example.en: The woman selling vegetables weighed the tomatoes on her scale.

整顿.gloss: to rectify; to reorganise; to consolidate

example.zh: 公司决定对管理制度进行整顿。
example.en: The company decided to overhaul its management system.

抹杀.gloss: to obliterate; to write off; to deny (achievements)

example.zh: 一次失败不能抹杀他多年的努力。
example.en: One failure can't wipe out his years of hard work.

example.zh: 他一个人的收入比我们三个人的总和还多。
example.en: His income alone is more than the three of ours combined.

example.zh: 我的父母很开明，尊重我的选择。
example.en: My parents are very open-minded and respect my choices.

example.zh: 今年房价上涨的幅度很大。
example.en: House prices have risen by a large margin this year.

example.zh: 他穿上警服显得特别威风。
example.en: He looks especially imposing in his police uniform.

压榨.gloss: to press; to squeeze; to exploit; to extract by pressing

example.zh: 这种油是用花生压榨出来的。
example.en: This oil is pressed from peanuts.

修养.indonesian: budi pekerti; kepribadian yang baik; pengetahuan dan keterampilan

example.zh: 他是一个很有修养的人，从不大声说话。
example.en: He is a very well-mannered person who never raises his voice.

example.zh: 这栋老楼存在很多安全隐患。
example.en: This old building has many hidden safety hazards.

example.zh: 他们之间有着真挚的友谊。
example.en: They share a sincere friendship.

申报.gloss: to declare (to customs); to report (to authorities); to apply

example.zh: 入境时，贵重物品要向海关申报。
example.en: When entering the country, valuables must be declared to customs.

example.zh: 我们不能用狭隘的眼光看问题。
example.en: We can't look at problems from a narrow point of view.

本钱.gloss: capital; principal; asset (what one can rely on)

example.zh: 身体健康是努力工作的本钱。
example.en: Good health is the capital you need to work hard.

example.zh: 这家公司几乎垄断了整个市场。
example.en: This company has almost monopolised the entire market.

example.zh: 这种茶有帮助消化的功效。
example.en: This tea has the effect of aiding digestion.

example.zh: 她买名牌包只是为了满足虚荣心。
example.en: She buys designer bags just to satisfy her vanity.

结算.gloss: to settle accounts; to close an account; settlement

example.zh: 我们每个月月底结算一次工资。
example.en: We settle wages once at the end of each month.

滞留.gloss: to be stranded; to be held up; to stay behind

example.zh: 因为大雪，很多旅客滞留在机场。
example.en: Because of heavy snow, many travellers were stranded at the airport.

治理.gloss: to govern; to administer; to bring under control; to tackle

example.zh: 这座城市花了很大力气治理空气污染。
example.en: The city has put great effort into tackling air pollution.

example.zh: 这辆卡车用的是柴油。
example.en: This truck runs on diesel.

example.zh: 很多志愿者无偿为老人提供服务。
example.en: Many volunteers serve the elderly free of charge.

新陈代谢.gloss: metabolism; the new superseding the old
新陈代谢.indonesian: metabolisme; yang baru menggantikan yang lama

example.zh: 多运动可以促进身体的新陈代谢。
example.en: Exercising more can boost the body's metabolism.

example.zh: 今天最高气温是三十五摄氏度。
example.en: Today's high is thirty-five degrees Celsius.

接连.gloss: one after another; in succession; in a row

example.zh: 他接连三天都没来上班。
example.en: He hasn't come to work for three days in a row.

惹祸.gloss: to stir up trouble; to cause trouble

example.zh: 这孩子太调皮了，总是惹祸。
example.en: This child is so naughty; he's always getting into trouble.

岔.gloss: fork (in a road); to branch off; to change (the subject)

example.zh: 走到前面的岔路口，你要往左拐。
example.en: When you reach the fork in the road ahead, turn left.

example.zh: 他们家的媳妇又能干又孝顺。
example.en: Their daughter-in-law is both capable and dutiful.
